item: Follow-ups to the T5 layout PR: the twice-read gate learns the three-letter codes, and the empty-ring caveat is tested from the rendered state
summary: The twice-read gate (vi ko as tl) is applied after normalising the primary code through TWICE_READ_ALIASES (kor vie tgl asm and fil), so a mistyped --language kor can no longer write kor.yml without the marker; the converter's check-tool lifts the table and runs its matrix for every alias; a test fails when the table is emptied. The empty-ring caveat test now extracts showRingMap from the shipped source and runs it on the real payload shapes in all twelve locales (all hidden, none indexed, unlocated-only, located). Decided: an unlocated-only payload keeps the standard country caveat beside its Not mapped bucket, because that sentence explains exactly the counts it still shows. Pinned in the same test.
